titles.native: インフィニティフォース

description:
Seventeen-year-old Emi Kaidou hasn't seen her father in ten years. She lives alone and feels increasingly disaffected, challenging the world to kill her and feeling empty when her daredevil behavior doesn't "pay off". All of that is about to change when she meets four heroes from alternate earths. When their worlds were eliminated by an evil man known only as “Z”, they instead came to Emi's, and together they determine to stop the destruction.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Full 3DCG anime project to celebrate the 55th anniversary of Tatsunoko Production. The anime has a different story from the original manga.
